injuries.description: the Plaintiff sustained a minor head injury because of the Accident.
source: the Plaintiff sustained a minor head injury because of the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of unspecified part of head

injuries.description: MRI performed on 16 April 2005 revealed probable foraminal compression of right C6 root and left C7 roots.

source: MRI performed on 16 April 2005 revealed probable foraminal compression of right C6 root and left C7 roots.

injuries.description: contusion injury of right middle finger (MF) over the proximal inter-phalangeal joint (PIPJ); contusion of right hand which resulted in rupture of extensor tendon to the right middle finger; diagnosis of extensor tendon central slip injury with flexible 'buttonhole' deformity of his right middle finger.
source: (iii) contusion injury of right middle finger (MF) over the proximal inter-phalangeal joint (PIPJ).
contusion of right hand which resulted in rupture of extensor tendon to the right middle finger.
there was flexible ‘buttonhole’ deformity of his right middle finger with supple joints. The diagnosis of his right middle finger problem was extensor tendon central slip injury.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of extensor muscle, fascia or tendon of other finger at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: The Plaintiff was subsequently diagnosed with recurrent laryngeal nerve palsy, likely related to intra-operative nerve fraction injury.
source: The Plaintiff was subsequently diagnosed with recurrent laryngeal nerve palsy, likely related to intra-operative nerve fraction injury.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified peripheral nerves of neck

manifestations.description: dizziness, nausea and vomiting on 22 May 2003
moderate degree of global cognitive dysfunction
weakness (MRC grade 3 to 4) over right upper limb
local tenderness over right shoulder; weakness over right upper limb
minimal active right MF PIPJ extension; good passive range of motion; pain and tenderness of right middle finger and palm
proximal interphalangeal joint held in a flexion contracture of 70°. There was no active extension. Active flexion is about 20°.
mild hoarseness of voice and sore throat
pain over his sacral area, left knee
walked with a stick; unsteady gait; cannot support himself on one leg; stated he cannot squat down
residual numbness of right hand and right middle finger

treatments_received: Ear, Nose and Throat (PWH Department of Ear, Nose and Throat)
Anterior decompression and disc replacement at C5/6 and C6/7 (operation)

losses.description: Right middle finger: extensor tendon injury/central slip injury leading to buttonhole deformity and inability to actively extend the PIPJ.
Residual headache, giddiness, impaired memory and a moderate degree of global cognitive dysfunction (post concussional features).
